It did fit in well enough to use, or so I thought, even thought the last 1/4 wouldn't turn for some reason.  Well, I discovered later that this was causing a slow leak under the refrigerator.  I bought 3 of these, will throw the other two out at this point.  I just re-ordered a different brand that claims to fit Kenmore 9915.  I wish I could find the actual Kenmore filters on Amazon.  I know they're 3-4 times more expensive, but if they don't cause a leak under your refrigerator, it's worth it.
